content.intro: This lesson covers Basic Workbook Organization as part of Excel Interface and Workbook Fundamentals. It follows the attached Excel curriculum, with an emphasis on small examples and verification.
content.why_it_matters: Basic Workbook Organization establishes the workbook structure and data-quality habits that later formulas and reports depend on. A clear layout reduces avoidable editing mistakes and makes the workbook easier for another person to understand. Compatibility: Check Microsoft’s function reference for the target Excel version, platform, and update channel. Dynamic-array spill behavior and some newer functions are not available in every legacy installation.
